whatsappMessage:
Hi Team JSFA - Jain Sahab Fitness Academy,

I noticed your gym has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://jsfa-fitness-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team JSFA, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Jain Sahab Fitness Academy) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with 5.0-star rating highlights, direct WhatsApp trial booking, and mobile-first speed for Patna fitness seekers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact training programs, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
